---
title: "🏒 Opening night is coming: preseason check"
---
About three weeks to the regular season. A quick once-over before players come back:

- [ ] **The new season is loaded.** The home page and a team sheet show this season's games (if not, see the July
      "New NHL season" reminder).
- [ ] **The domain renews.** Porkbun → Domain Management → stickpicks.hockey: auto-renew on, card on file current.
- [ ] **Backups are working.** Actions → "Back up the database": the last few Sundays succeeded. Your
      BACKUP_PASSPHRASE is still in your password manager.
- [ ] **Google still lists the site.** Search Console → Pages and Sitemaps show no errors.
- [ ] **Plan the opening-week push.** Friends first, then team subreddits and podcasts (see the outreach notes).
- [ ] **Look at last season's weekly reports** (Issues → label "weekly-report") for what brought players in.
